mentions.name: JTrack
mentions.description: A SaaS app that turns a process into an interactive flowchart users follow step by step, so teams can define a process, share instructions, and collect data all in one place. Near code-complete on the MVP and moving into distribution.
mentions.problem: After years working in manufacturing, the builder struggled to find software where a team could define a process, share instructions, and collect data all in one go.
mentions.audience: Manufacturing teams and other non-technical users
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m just putting the finishing touches on (https://jtrack.app)[JTrack]

I spent a long time working in manufacturing and struggled to find a piece of software where we could define a process, share instructions and collect data all in one go.

The idea is you can basically turn your process into an interactive flowchart and follow it through.
